sentences.text: Perusal of the allegations in present FIR and the subsequent FIR No. 1171 of 2023 indicates that the allegations are identical inasmuch as the vehicle carrying contraband material (Gutkha Pan Masala etc.),
sentences._hearing_file: Prakash Premaramji Bhati vs The State Of Maharashtra on 7 August, 2025.json

sentences.text: the driver of the vehicle has named the present Applicant as a person for whom the contraband was being carried or on whose instance the said contraband is stated to be carried.

sentences.text:
6. Today, learned Counsel for the Applicant submits that in 3 earlier FIRs namely 948/2020,
1143/2020 and 795/2022, the Applicant has been acquitted.
sentences._hearing_file: Prakash Premaramji Bhati vs The State Of Maharashtra on 7 August, 2025.json

sentences.text: He submits that the application of Section 328 of IPC to Gutkha is pending before the Hon'ble Supreme Court and submits that on this count alone, the anticipatory bail application be allowed.
sentences._hearing_file: Prakash Premaramji Bhati vs The State Of Maharashtra on 7 August, 2025.json

sentences.text: 7. It is already noted in the last order that record indicates that Applicant's name is cropping up at the instance of various drivers when the vehicles are intercepted carrying the same contraband material.
sentences._hearing_file: Prakash Premaramji Bhati vs The State Of Maharashtra on 7 August, 2025.json

sentences.text: 8. Learned APP on instructions of concerned Investigating Officer (who is present in the Court) has strenuously opposed this application on the ground that considering various FIRs, the Applicant is a habitual offender and is a supplier of the contraband material involved in the FIR.
sentences._hearing_file: Prakash Premaramji Bhati vs The State Of Maharashtra on 7 August, 2025.json

sentences.text: It is contended that even after interim protection is secured from this Court in the present matter, subsequent FIR No. 1171 of 2023 is filed in the same area and therefore, no indulgence been shown.
sentences._hearing_file: Prakash Premaramji Bhati vs The State Of Maharashtra on 7 August, 2025.json

sentences.text: 9. In the aforesaid facts and circumstances, considering that the Applicant's name is taken time and again by various drivers of vehicles carrying same contraband material, and considering that after interim 47-ABA-2926-2023.doc order by this Court, the Applicant's name has again surfaced in connection with subsequent FIR No. 1171/2023, serious note will have to be taken about the Applicant's alleged continued involvement in similar activities.
sentences._hearing_file: Prakash Premaramji Bhati vs The State Of Maharashtra on 7 August, 2025.json

sentences.text: Therefore the Applicant will have to be put to terms.
sentences._hearing_file: Prakash Premaramji Bhati vs The State Of Maharashtra on 7 August, 2025.json

sentences.text:
10. Hence, the following order:
(i) The anticipatory bail application is allowed in terms of order dated 19.10.2023.
sentences._hearing_file: Prakash Premaramji Bhati vs The State Of Maharashtra on 7 August, 2025.json

sentences.text: (ii) It is clarified that if the Applicant's name surfaces during investigation in any subsequent FIR involving transport of Gutkha, present anticipatory bail granted in favour of Applicant will be vacated automatically.
sentences._hearing_file: Prakash Premaramji Bhati vs The State Of Maharashtra on 7 August, 2025.json

sentences.text: 9. Anticipatory bail application is disposed of in above terms.
sentences._hearing_file: Prakash Premaramji Bhati vs The State Of Maharashtra on 7 August, 2025.json

opennyai_summary.19_October_2023__decision:
3. The applicant apprehends arrest in connection with the aforesaid crime as the co-accused in whose possession the contraband articles - Gutakha Pan masala, has been seized, has named the applicant as the privy to the offences.
4.
In identical matter, this Court has granted interim relief and posted the matters for consideration on 31st October, 2023 as the question of applicability of 913 aba 2926 of 2023.doc Section 328 of the Penal Code in a case of the present nature awaits decision of the Supreme Court.
In view of the above, in the event of arrest of the applicant in CR No.289 of 2022, registered with Taloja Police Station, Navi Mumbai, the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a PR Bond in the sum of Rs.30,000/- with one or two sureties in the like amount.
The applicant shall cooperate with the investigation and report to the Investigating Officer as and when directed.
6. The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence and give threat or inducement to the first informant and any person acquainted with the facts of the case.
